_doc: NCL TH-cell delay probability models for stat-sim, extracted from transistor-level Vt-mismatch Monte-Carlo (SG13G2 PSP103, N=200/level) in mylex nulex/asic/chr/mc/RESULTS.md. Each cell: mu_ps = characterized mean set-arc delay per kvt (mismatch scale), sd_ps = MC std-dev. The transferable mismatch model is sigma_frac(kvt)=sd/mu; it is ~linear in kvt (zero-mean per-device Vt adds spread, not bias). arc = the input the single-cell MC triggered (weight-2 'a' for th34w2); composed designs may exercise other arcs (mu differs; sigma_frac transfers).

ground_truth_nclfa._doc: Real transistor MC of the composed full adder (aH->sH weight-1 arc, 1 gate), for validating stat-sim 1-gate composition.

ground_truth_nclfa4._doc: Real transistor MC of the 4-bit ripple adder's coH (4-deep th23 carry chain, worst-case ripple A=1111,B=0000,Cin=1; 240 devices), for validating stat-sim MULTI-GATE composition + the 1/sqrt(N) averaging law.

arcs._doc: PER-ARC characterization (isolated single-cell MC at 2 fF fanout load). Shows sigma_frac is arc-INDEPENDENT (transfers, ~matches the cell model) while mu is arc- AND slew-dependent. mu@fast = mu at a sharp 0.2ns primary-input edge.

th23_cin.arc: carry-in (a held high, c rises last; A.C branch)

in_context_carry_ps._doc: IN-CONTEXT per-stage carry delays, extracted from the nclfa4 chain by probing the internal carries (ci->c1->c2->c3->coH). The two MIDDLE stages are identical (358.4, 358.2) -> t_ctx is a stable TILEABLE primitive (a carry gate driven by a real prior carry, driving its real fanout = next th23 + sum th34w2). Boundaries differ: t_first (primary-input sharp edge) and t_last (lightly-loaded output). Model: mu(N) = t_first + (N-2)*t_ctx + t_last. This closes the mu gap the isolated single-arc (245ps) could not: in-context per-stage is 358ps (real-cell RC fanout + NCL dual-rail completion + coincident DATA arrival). sigma per stage = sigma_frac(th23,kvt)*t_stage; chain sigma = RSS (validated vs nclfa4 MC within ~7%).

in_context_sum_ps._doc: th34w2 sum gate IN-CONTEXT (FA sH, weight-1 arc with the real coL side-input net) = the FA tvalid mean. Isolated weight-1 arc was 333ps; in-context (real coL net + FA loading) is 397ps.

slew_delay_th23_cin._doc: th23 carry arc delay (c->y, nominal) vs input-edge slew (12-108% ps), 2 fF load. Delay IS strongly slew-dependent. NOTE: this does NOT explain the ripple's in-chain per-stage (~373ps vs isolated 245ps): the measured th23 carry OUTPUT slew at 2fF is only ~143ps (fast), so slew degradation is ruled out. The residual is an IN-CONTEXT effect (real-cell RC load + NCL dual-rail completion + coincident DATA arrival) that needs in-context timing, not a single isolated arc. sigma_frac (reliability) still composes; absolute mu is the open item.
